sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Nullifies Cost reduction for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Disaster Collapse (reduces action speed by 30, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, extends cooldown times by 30%, and reduces status ailment resistance by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000

[Strongest Synergist] Hajime Nagumo or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
